rules.statement: The question whether an actual partition or a sale should be ordered should be gone into and determined by the Court as part of the proceedings preliminary to the interlocutory decree, which should, when entered, definitely order a partition or a sale, as the case may be.
rules.supporting_quote: As the necessity for such applications frequently arises under similar circumstances, it may be convenient to settle the practice which should be followed in partition cases. In my opinion the question whether an actual partition or a sale should be ordered should be gone into and determined by the Court as part of the proceedings preliminary to the interlocutory decree, which should, when entered, definitely order a partition or a sale, as the case may be.
